disorder-name.detail: Pediatric patients with refractory epilepsy undergoing peri-insular hemispherotomy. Two subgroups: 29 left hemispherotomy and 28 right hemispherotomy patients (total N=57). NM was applied to derive age-adjusted GMV values for both pre- and post-operative scans.
disorder-name.supporting_text: "Pediatric patients with refractory epilepsy undergoing peri-insular hemispherotomy were recruited in our present study."

dataset-of-origin.detail: Single site: Pediatric Epilepsy Center, Peking University First Hospital, Beijing, China. Patients recruited between 2016 and 2021.
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "underwent peri-insular hemispherotomy between 2016 and 2021 at the Pediatric Epilepsy Center, Peking University First Hospital"

age.detail: Age of surgery. Left hemispherotomy (N=29): mean=3.5, SD=2.5, range 0.7–10.6; Right hemispherotomy (N=28): mean=4.6, SD=2.5, range 1.1–11.0. Combined (N=57): weighted mean=(29×3.5+28×4.6)/57=4.04, pooled SD=√((28×6.25+27×6.25)/55)=2.50, min=0.7, max=11.0.

sex.detail: Left hemispherotomy: 16M/13F (N=29); Right hemispherotomy: 16M/12F (N=28). Combined total: 32M/25F (N=57). Percentages calculated from combined counts: male 32/57=56.1%, female 25/57=43.9%.
